init_train_state: initialize a PyTorch model training state with an optimizer and optional frozen parameters
restore_train_state: restore a saved training state from a pickle checkpoint file on disk
save_train_state: save the current training state to a pickle checkpoint file for later restoration
StepCountEstimator_add_measurement: add an elapsed seconds measurement to the step count estimator for tracking training throughput
StepCountEstimator_estimated_steps_per_s: get the estimated steps per second from the exponential moving average of elapsed time
